name: high_society_hunter_declined_sacrifice_no_counter
notes: M5 mapper. Printed: 'Whenever this creature attacks, you may sacrifice another creature. If you do, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.' High-Society Hunter attacks; seat 0 declines the sacrifice ('skip'): the Bear stays, no counter, and the Hunter deals 5. Then seat 1's Soldier token dies: 'another nontoken creature dies' does not see a token, so no card is drawn.
